title: Discovery
description: We learn your goals, audience, competitors, and success metrics through workshops and research. You leave with a shared brief—what success looks like, constraints, and priorities.

title: Strategy
description: We define positioning, channel mix, timelines, and KPIs aligned with your business objectives. Scope, milestones, and owners are clear before design or ads start.

title: Design & Development
description: Our team designs and builds iteratively with your feedback at every milestone. You review working progress—not surprises at the end.

title: Testing
description: QA, performance checks, and user validation ensure everything works flawlessly before launch. We catch bugs, slow pages, and unclear flows early.

title: Launch
description: We deploy, monitor, and hand off with documentation plus ongoing optimization support—so your team knows what shipped and what to measure next.
